apps/model-host.why: PACKAGE.ts runs test/serve.test.mjs and test/transcript.test.mjs, and both bundle src/ with esbuild (build.mjs) and run the bundle, so no resolver reaches the twin (finding E-8). Verifying it needs the build to compile .vibe (vibelang-unplugin), which is cutover work.

apps/app.why: PACKAGE.ts unitTests runs bun over these folders: ~17K tests, 10-18 minutes, too heavy to run twice per iteration on the mini. Both runs use the test files whose relative imports reach a twinned module. Direct importers only while translating (the app entry reaches nearly every test transitively); the full suite runs once on a lane VM before the package counts for cutover.
